goal: Create a minimal source-driven routes.json Node plugin. Call code-map {}, export-snapshot include ["routes.json"], read-source by sourceId, import-conventions notes/sourceIds, then get output/case schemas. Compute the exact case route ID using get-capabilities schema=identity,kind=route,slots={scopeId:repo.repo.main,routerId:app,mode:history,declaredPath:/orders}. Script under 100 lines, JSON.parse current source content, emit each current route using source routerId/mode, actual UTF-8 evidence, no fixed facts. Use includeIdentityHelper=true and identity.mjs artifact. File writes merge and can be split across calls. Include ONE meaningful case requiring the exact /orders entityId and its CollectorInput fixture from export with stageId=extract. truthRef/truthHash are optional; if supplied they must identify an exact exported original source with matching hash (the host now copies those bytes automatically). Do not remove or weaken a valid case. After all files exist call validate-plugin, fix structured issues within budget, and stop after activation.

investigation.notes:
Investigation of routes source (project "live-project", scope repo.repo.main):

1. Single route-registry source: `routes.json` at repository root (`repo.main`, sourceClass=config, encoding UTF-8 with CRLF line ending). Exported sourceId `src_b2dd364bf4438e6e3826e795629e5d8693507bb127b52cde0afbbdf8ca98ffce`, contentHash `ed7c08383e568fcdcbbe6daae45d60f4cc8c9534d04ba85e3524bcb292a3f102`, byteLength 124 (read-source status=current, coverage=complete).

2. Confirmed document shape (observed from current bytes): top-level object with `routerId` (string, currently "app"), `mode` (string, currently "history"), and `routes` (array of objects with `path` (string, leading-slash declared path, currently "/orders" and "/inventory") and `name` (string display name)). Derived 124-byte content ends with "\r\n".

3. Route identity convention (from Core identity schema, kind=route): required slots `scopeId`, `routerId`, `mode`, `declaredPath`. For the current file this yields two routes; the /orders entity ID computed via Core identity service with slots {scopeId:"repo.repo.main", routerId:"app", mode:"history", declaredPath:"/orders"} = `ent_d023c5b7b1847d6433677bfab770467189c7f74667609124f1f89523aff31a3f` (memory only — not a hardcoded script output; script must always recompute from current source).

4. No frontend framework, HTTP API, or DB mapping registered yet (status shows api/database/frontend/report/workflow coverage = not_configured; routes = not_configured). The plugin therefore only implements the `routes` capability in an `extract` phase over the source set selected by include pattern `routes.json`; no relation-building (link) stage is justified by current sources.

5. Evidence rule adopted: emit one evidence entry per route using the actual UTF-8 byte offsets of the route object within the current source text (Buffer.byteLength prefix slicing), plus whole-file evidence, referencing the source's own id/contentHash from CollectorInput rather than any snapshot-time constants. Unknown/extra fields, missing routerId/mode, non-array routes, or duplicate (routerId,mode,path) are emitted as coverage gaps instead of guessed facts.
